title: Flow log report
description: One record of the `flow_logs` array POSTed to the portal's /ingestion/flow_logs endpoint. connlib's flow-tracker emits it, flow-log-writer spools it, and PortalAPI.FlowLogController ingests it; the test suites on both sides check against this file, so a field one side renames or drops fails that side's CI. Attribution deliberately rides the request's ingest token, not the record.

inner_src_ip.description: Tunnel IP of the initiator, on both sides' reports.

inner_dst_ip.description: Tunnel IP of the responder, on both sides' reports.

domain.description: Domain name for flows to DNS Resources; absent otherwise.

outers.description: Outer (transport) paths in observation order, appended on every change, so a path the flow returned to appears again.

src_ip.description: Absent together with src_port when the source is unknown, i.e. for relayed sends.

path_activated_at.description: Time of the packet that revealed the path: the flow's first packet for the initial entry, the first packet after a change for every later one.

flow_end.description: Absent on the open report; the close report carries it together with last_packet and the counters.
